overview_description.description:
Kry offers digital healthcare services that help patients to make active choices about their health in partnership with public and private healthcare professionals. It specializes in the fields of healthcare, E-health, and Digital health.

Kry was founded in 2015 and headquartered in Stockholms Lan, Sweden.

about_short_description.short_description: Kry helps patients to make active choices about their health in partnership with public and private healthcare professionals.

product.name: Digital Primary Care
product.description: A service providing patients with access to healthcare professionals via video calls and chat for diagnosis, treatment, and advice.

product.name: Physical Primary Care Clinics
product.description: Physical healthcare centers offering in-person medical services including specialist consultations and treatments.

product.name: Specialist Care Services
product.description: Specialized medical services including dermatology, child and adolescent psychiatry, and behavioral psychology.

product.name: Home Testing Services
product.description: At-home diagnostic test kits for conditions like sexually transmitted infections and fungal infections, with results delivered digitally.

product.name: Health Checkups and Blood Tests
product.description: Health screening packages including blood tests to assess risks for various diseases and nutritional deficiencies.

product.name: Digital Child and Adolescent Psychiatry (BUP)
product.description: A digital psychiatric service for children and adolescents aged 8-17, offering assessments and treatments for mental health conditions.
